findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink

Untrusted content: list_breakpoint_events, get_device, list_devices, list_device_events, test_pac_connection, get_screen_share_recording, get_my_account, get_device_egress_status, search_entries, list_entries, get_entry, inspect_requests, list_store_apps, get_store_app, share_advisor_finding, list_issue_reports, download_snapshot, get_status · Private data: get_device, test_pac_connection, list_screen_share_recordings, get_my_account, get_entry, inspect_requests, list_snapshots, download_snapshot, list_push_tokens, get_status, list_audit_events, get_audit_event · Public sink: list_devices, list_device_events, list_screen_share_recordings, get_screen_share_recording, get_my_account, share_advisor_finding, list_push_tokens, list_audit_events · Destructive: list_devices, get_device_health, list_device_events, list_screen_share_recordings, share_advisor_finding, get_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_breakpoint_events, get_device, list_devices, list_device_events, test_pac_connection, get_screen_share_recording, get_my_account, get_device_egress_status, search_entries, list_entries, get_entry, inspect_requests, list_store_apps, get_store_app, share_advisor_finding, list_issue_reports, download_snapshot, get_status · Private data: get_device, test_pac_connection, list_screen_share_recordings, get_my_account, get_entry, inspect_requests, list_snapshots, download_snapshot, list_push_tokens, get_status, list_audit_events, get_audit_event · Public sink: list_devices, list_device_events, list_screen_share_recordings, get_screen_share_recording, get_my_account, share_advisor_finding, list_push_tokens, list_audit_events · Destructive: list_devices, get_device_health, list_device_events, list_screen_share_recordings, share_advisor_finding, get_status
